shortDescription: Polymarket’s Kansas City Royals vs. Houston Astros market saw the “Over” option in the Kansas City Royals O/U 1.5 submarket swing sharply, falling from 78.5% one hour earlier to 50%, a 28.5 percentage point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move may reflect the impact of a sudden news event.
